title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta38

## Restore resource-driven LiDAR capability

This beta fixes a regression introduced by the explicit model capability optimization in beta35.

The original LiDAR backend added in beta4 was intentionally **resource-driven**: if the mower exposes a valid vendor `type=2` terrain package, Navimower can use it regardless of the mower model name. Beta35 accidentally made the frontend `terrain_overlay.supported` flag depend on the known model-family table instead, which meant a proven H2 terrain resource could still be reported as unsupported to the Map Card.

### What changes

- `frontend.terrain_overlay.supported` is once again derived from a successfully downloaded and validated vendor `type=2` terrain package.
- The existing model capability flag remains only as a **polling hint** so already-known LiDAR families can be checked more promptly.
- Unknown/non-listed models still receive conservative discovery checks, so **H2 and future models** exposing the same valid terrain resource can become supported automatically.
- Mowers without a terrain resource remain on the slow unavailable cadence and do not create fast recurring cloud traffic.
- Diagnostics now expose both the resource-driven support source and the model hint separately.

### Map Card pairing

Navimower Map Card **0.3.7-beta27** already consumes `frontend.terrain_overlay.supported` for editor visibility, so no H2-specific Map Card rule is required. Once beta38 has validated/cached the mower's type-2 terrain resource, LiDAR terrain/elevation settings become available in the card editor through the existing generic capability contract.
